why: A defunct Los Osos motel in West Wind Estate, repurposed by Scavengers as a cyberware chop-shop and squat. This proposal loads the motel's quest prefabs and restores its ambient occupation: armed Scav guards on the first and second floors, a netrunner at her post, and the junkies and homeless who live in the ground-floor rooms and lot, with two parked cars outside. The gig's people and crime-scene dressing (Leon Rinder, the miniboss, blood and clue props, the dog tag) stay out.

open_questions: Check the guard poses on the first and second floors. No spot map was found for these communities (the motel's EP1 exterior sector will not convert), so confirm the guards stand or patrol calmly rather than crouched behind cover, alert or in a combat stance.
Check the netrunner's post on the first floor. goon_10 should be seated or working at her station, not standing in a combat stance.
Walk in through the front double doors and the yard gate. Confirm the sliding doors open on approach and the gate or garage shutter can be opened by some in-world means.
Look at the third floor. It should be dark and empty: no Rinder, no bed or medical setup, no blood, clue props or dog tag.
Check the ground-floor rooms and lot. The junkies, homeless and two parked cars should be present and calm, with no scripted hobo-versus-vending-machine scene.
Check the lot gate and the front of the building. The entrance covers variant should stay off, so the facade looks like an ordinary squatted motel, not a fortified combat position.
